  1. common.definitions
  2. CommonModel

Uses of Class
common.definitions.CommonModel

Packages that use CommonModel
Package
Description
common.definitions
Definition of the JMT simulation model data structure (CommonModel, StationDefinition, ClassDefinition, ...) shared by JSIMgraph and JSIMwiz.
common.definitions.convertors
Converters of the JMT model definitions.
common.xml
XML reading and writing of the JMT model file format, the XML data layer that enables full reusability of the computational engines.
jmt.jmch
The JMCH tool: a modelling classroom helper that applies a simulation technique to solve single station models, as described in the user manual.
jmva.engine
Dispatcher of the JMVA GUI: it collects the model from the panels, runs the selected solution algorithm and returns the results for display.
jsimgraph.definitions
Definition interfaces of the JSIMgraph model data source, shared between the graph editor and the model layer.
jsimgraph.template
Model templates of JSIMgraph, used to quickly create new simulation models.
jsimwiz
JSIMwiz application entry point: the wizard based interface for the JSIM discrete event simulator.
jsimwiz.definitions
Definition interfaces of the JSIMwiz textual wizard model layer.
